1.w: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you⁺ indeed [is] not troublesome to me, and [is] secure for you⁺.

2.w: Look out for the dogs! Look out for the evil workers! Look out for the mutilation!

3.w: For we are the circumcision, those worshiping in the Spirit of God and boasting in Christ Jesus, and not having put confidence in the flesh—

4.w: though I have confidence even in the flesh. If any other thinks to have confidence in the flesh, I more:

5.w: circumcision [on] the eighth day; of the nation of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin; a Hebrew of Hebrews; according to the law, a Pharisee;

6.w: according to zeal, persecuting the church; according to righteousness that [is] in the law, having become blameless.

7.w: But whatever things were gain to me, these I have deemed loss because of Christ.

8.w: But indeed, therefore, I also deem all things to be loss because of the surpassing knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord, because of whom I have lost all things and deem [them] rubbish, that I may gain Christ

9.w: and may be found in Him, not having my own righteousness that [is] of the law, but that which [is] through faith from Christ, the righteousness of God upon faith,

10.w: to know Him and the power of His resurrection and the fellowship of His sufferings, being conformed to His death,

11.w: if somehow I may attain to the resurrection out from the dead.

12.w: Not that I already obtained [it] or already have been perfected, but I pursue, if also I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.

13.w: Brothers, I do not reckon myself to have taken hold [of it]. But one thing: Indeed, forgetting the things behind and stretching forward to the things ahead,

14.w: I pursue toward the goal for the prize of the upward calling of God in Christ Jesus.

15.w: Therefore as many as [are] mature, we should be of this mind. And if you⁺ are minded [in] anything differently, even this God will reveal to you⁺.

16.w: However, to that which we have attained, walk by the same.

17.w: Be imitators together of me, brothers, and look at those walking thus, as you⁺ have a pattern in us.

18.w: For many walk—[of] whom I told you⁺ often, and now I say even weeping—[as] enemies of the cross of Christ,

19.w: whose end [is] destruction, whose god [is] the belly and [their] glory [is] in their shame, those minding earthly things.

20.w: For our citizenship is in the heavens, from where also we eagerly await a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,

21.w: who will transform our body of humiliation [to be] conformed to the body of His glory, according to the working of His powering, even to subject all things to Himself.
